description: Phase 2 — Billing + stock engine. Pure money/quantity math in integer paise, transactional + idempotent checkout with FOR UPDATE row locks and exactly-once stock deduction, stock_movements audit trail, negative-stock guard, hold/reopen, history, and controlled cancel/refund reversal. Depends on FEAT-001 (tables, Prisma models, RBAC, session). Grounded in design §4–§5 and the existing prisma.$transaction / $queryRawUnsafe usage.
steps: api-node/src/services/posBilling.ts: create the pure engine — round2/paise math, line_total, line_tax, subtotal, tax_total, grand_total (§4.3), quantity (>0, <=50000, DECIMAL(10,3)) / rate (0..100000) / discount (0..subtotal) validation, and the bill-number formatter. ALWAYS recompute catalogue-line totals from the authoritative product price/tax_rate; never trust client totals. Fix §4.2 off-by-one (NIT 1): seed pos_next_bill_seq=0 OR read-then-increment so the first invoice is INV-000001.

api-node/src/routes/pos.ts: create router mounted /api/pos (all requireAuth). GET /products/search?q= (requireStaff('pos')) by name/SKU/barcode returning id,name,sku,barcode,unit,price,tax_rate,stock,in_stock.

api-node/src/routes/pos.ts: POST /bills (requireStaff('pos')) — idempotency pre-check SELECT by idempotency_key (return existing bill {idempotent:true} if found); prisma.$transaction: SELECT ... FOR UPDATE the catalogue products, recompute money, stock check honoring per-product allow_negative_stock + global pos_allow_negative_stock (409 {message,productId} if insufficient, nothing written), reserve bill number in-tx, insert pos_bills (+idempotency_key) + pos_bill_items, UPDATE products SET stock=stock-q, in_stock=(…), insert stock_movements reason='sale'; on uq_pos_bills_idem race (P2002/1062) re-select and return existing.

api-node/src/routes/pos.ts: POST /bills/hold (no stock move, bill_no=NULL, status='held', returns id); GET /bills (keyset pagination + filters); GET /bills/:billNo (completed/cancelled/refunded + items); GET /bills/id/:id (reopen held).

api-node/src/routes/pos.ts: POST /bills/:billNo/cancel and /refund (requireStaff('pos')) — in a tx, guard status==='completed' (idempotent no-op otherwise), restock each catalogue line, recompute in_stock, insert stock_movements reversal rows (positive change_qty, reason cancel_reversal|refund_reversal), set status + cancelled_by + cancel_reason.

api-node/src/__tests__/posBilling.test.ts: unit-test the money math (paise rounding, 0.5 kg / 500 g lines, ₹1 and ₹100000 bounds). Write the idempotency/transaction proof: same idempotencyKey twice => one bill, stock deducted once; cancel restores once; second cancel is a no-op. If the DB is unreachable here, write the test, state it needs the deploy DB, and include a precise transaction + idempotency-key code walkthrough proving exactly-once.
acceptance_criteria: posBilling money math unit test passes (paise rounding, decimal weights, ₹1 and ₹100000 bounds).

POST /api/pos/bills is idempotent: the idempotency test (or documented DB-gated test + code walkthrough) proves a retried/duplicated checkout deducts stock exactly once and cancel restores it (acceptance d).
Insufficient stock with negative-stock off returns 409 and writes nothing; with the owner setting on the bill succeeds.
All /api/pos/* endpoints are server-side guarded with requireStaff('pos').
`npm --prefix ...\api-node run build` shows only expected prisma.<posModel> delegate errors.
verification: Run `npm --prefix c:\xampp\htdocs\static4a\.worktrees\pos-billing\4astore-v2\api-node run build`; only expected prisma delegate errors.
Run the posBilling unit test (node:test) and confirm the money-math and idempotency assertions pass (or the DB-gated note is present with the walkthrough).
findings:
Phase-2 billing + stock engine complete. KEY FILES/SYMBOLS for later features:

PURE ENGINE — api-node/src/services/posBilling.ts (NO Express/Prisma/DB import; unit-tested directly). Exports: toPaise/fromPaise/round2 (integer-paise money math, NO floats); QTY_MAX=50000, RATE_MAX=100000, QTY_DP=3; validateQuantity (>0, <=50000, <=3dp), validateRate (0..100000), validateTaxRate (0..100); computeLine(BillLineInput)->ComputedLine (lineBase=round2(qty*rate), lineTax=round2(lineBase*taxRate/100), lineTotal=lineBase+lineTax — TAX-INCLUSIVE per design §4.3); computeBill(lines, discount)->ComputedBill {lines, subtotal=Σ lineBase, discount(clamped 0..subtotal), taxTotal=Σ lineTax, grandTotal=round2(subtotal-discount+taxTotal)}; formatBillNo(prefix,seq)->'INV-000001' (seq>=1 enforced, NIT-1 off-by-one fixed, pads to 6); paymentStatusFor(grand,paid)->'paid'|'partial'|'pending'; BillValidationError. REUSE computeBill/round2 in Excel import (FEAT-003) and reports (FEAT-004) for money math; invoice renderers (FEAT-005) should read the stored DECIMAL totals, not recompute.

ROUTES — api-node/src/routes/pos.ts mounted at /api/pos in server.ts (AFTER /api/pos/auth so the public login path still wins; BOTH before generic /api catalog). router.use(requireAuth) + every route also requireStaff('pos'). Endpoints: GET /products/search?q= (name contains OR sku/barcode prefix/exact, LIMIT 25, returns id,name,sku,barcode,unit,price,tax_rate,stock,in_stock); POST /bills (idempotent completed checkout); POST /bills/hold (held, no stock move, bill_no NULL, returns bill.id); GET /bills (keyset: ?limit<=100&cursor=<id>&status=&mobile=&billNo=, returns {bills,nextCursor}); GET /bills/id/:id (reopen held / any bill by numeric id); GET /bills/:billNo (completed/cancelled/refunded by bill_no); POST /bills/:billNo/cancel and /refund.

IDEMPOTENT CHECKOUT (acceptance d) — POST /bills requires idempotencyKey (uuid) for status='completed' (422 if missing). Flow: (1) pre-check loadBillByIdemKey() OUTSIDE tx — if found return {bill,idempotent:true} and DO NOTHING ELSE (safe refresh/retry => deduct once). (2) prisma.$transaction(async tx): lock catalogue rows `SELECT ... FROM products WHERE id IN (...) FOR UPDATE`; recompute money with server-authoritative price/tax_rate (CLIENT rate IGNORED for catalogue lines; manual lines trust client rate); aggregate demand per product; stock check honours per-product allow_negative_stock then global settings.pos_allow_negative_stock, else throw CheckoutError(409,'Insufficient stock for <name>',productId) BEFORE any write; reserve bill_no in-tx via `UPDATE settings SET pos_next_bill_seq = pos_next_bill_seq+1` then SELECT it back (same conn, no race) + formatBillNo; INSERT pos_bills(+idempotency_key) + pos_bill_items; per product UPDATE products SET stock=stock-q,in_stock=(after>0 OR allowNeg) + INSERT stock_movements reason='sale' change_qty=-q balance_after. (3) RACE BACKSTOP: on 1062/P2002 (isDuplicateKeyError) re-select by key and return {idempotent:true}. 409 payload carries {message,productId} via failWith(). Totals snapshot authoritative product NAME + sku into pos_bill_items.

CANCEL/REFUND (acceptance g) — POST /bills/:billNo/{cancel,refund}: tx locks the bill FOR UPDATE; IDEMPOTENT no-op unless status==='completed' (returns bill unchanged — no double restock); restock each CATALOGUE line (skips is_manual / null product_id), recompute in_stock, INSERT stock_movements reason='cancel_reversal'|'refund_reversal' positive change_qty same bill_no; set status + cancelled_by + cancel_reason. Body {reason?}.

RAW-SQL CONVENTION — pos_bills/pos_bill_items/stock_movements are read/written via $queryRawUnsafe/$executeRawUnsafe because the worktree Prisma client is un-generated (prisma.<posModel> delegates missing). `products` is touched via raw SQL inside the tx so FOR UPDATE + atomic decrement are explicit. All money returned as number via num()/round2 at the JSON boundary (Prisma Decimal arrives as string from raw SQL). LAST_INSERT_ID() is per-connection safe inside the tx. Manual-item lines require settings.pos_allow_manual_items=1 (else 403).

NOTIFICATIONS NOT WIRED HERE — design §4.4 step-3 after-commit sale/low-stock push is intentionally LEFT to FEAT-005 (posNotify); checkout commits bill+stock+movements only. FEAT-005 should hook after the $transaction resolves (fire-and-forget, never block the response) using the computed grand_total + the post-deduction product stock vs low_stock_threshold.

TESTS — api-node/src/__tests__/posBilling.test.ts (21 assertions incl. the 3 catalog-leak), run via `npm test`. Part 1 money math (paise rounding, 0.5kg/500g, ₹1/₹100000 bounds, qty 0<..<=50000, discount<=subtotal, GST rollup, INV-000001). Part 2 acceptance-d EXACTLY-ONCE: DB is unreachable in the worktree so the HTTP round-trip is DB-gated (documented 4-step live-DB walkthrough) and proved from source — the test readFileSync's routes/pos.ts and asserts the load-bearing invariants (pre-check before tx; {idempotent:true} short-circuit; FOR UPDATE lock; UNIQUE-key race backstop re-select; 409 aborts writing nothing; cancel no-ops unless completed) are present + ordered, plus deterministic single-apply stock-after math. NOTE: tsc build compiles tests (module CommonJS) so AVOID import.meta in test files — resolve paths via process.cwd() (npm-test cwd = api-node root).

VERIFICATION — `npm run build` = 173 tsc errors vs 161 baseline; the 12 new errors are ALL in routes/pos.ts and ALL the EXPECTED un-generated-prisma classes (8× TS2347 untyped $queryRawUnsafe<T> type-args, 4× TS7006 implicit-any tx/r/b) — identical signatures already in baseline (seoQueue/video/queue). ZERO new errors in any other file; posBilling.ts + the test compile clean. `npm test` 21/21 pass.
